page.layout: One page of text, single column, a dedication to named persons with paragraphs set as full-width entries; no margin notes; no running head or page number printed.

main_text.head: Amplissimis, Consultissimis, Prudentissimis, Gravissimis, Pietatis, Generisque splendore conspicuis Viris.
main_text.p: Dn. JOH. FRIDERICO RYHINERO, Praefecturis olim in Brandis & Trachselwald / laudatissimè defuncto, Senatori nunc Reip. Consultissimo, Avo suo omni filialis honoris, amoris & observantiae cultu ad tumulum usque prosequendo.

Dn. ANTONIO KNECHTIO, Ducentûm Viro Gravissimo, Praefecturis ante hac Inferioris Xenodochii & Brandis / dignissimè defuncto, nunc Rei Salariae Curatori meritissimo, suo è Sacra Baptismatis unda susceptori ad aras usque amando, colendo.
Dn. JOH. JACOBO OTTHONI, Ducentiro Dignissimo, Scholarchae Meritissimo, Spectatissimo, Praefecto in Erlach / maximo cum applausu electo, Avunculo suo ad cineres usque, Summis honoribus afficiundo.

Dn. JOH. HENRICO OTTHONI, olim in Academia Lausannensi Professori Celeberrimo, nunc verò Ecclesiae, quae Christo in Ruexovia colligitur, Pastori Vigilantissimo; Avunculo suo, nullo honoris & obsequii genere satis demerendo.
Dn. ALBERTO BENEDICTO, Med: Doct. Civitatisque Bernensis Medico Insulano Excellentissimo, Patri suo, dum Spiritus hos reget artus, omni filiali honore, amore, & obsequiô suspiciundo, devenerando.

p.i: Hancce dissertationem, ea, quâ par est, animi devotione,

page.notes: The Ducentiro in the third paragraph is as printed in the scan (line reads "Ducen-/Viro"); the hyphenated word is Ducenviro-type and is uncertain. Several names printed in black letter (Brandis, Trachselwald, Erlach) are rendered as plain text here; the signature line is only partly legible at the foot.
